features: POWERFUL 30W STEREO SOUND: Experience room-filling audio with a 2.1 channel system featuring a dedicated wooden subwoofer and dual satellite speakers for deep bass and crystal-clear treble.
PREMIUM GUNMETAL BLACK DESIGN: Featuring a modern, space-saving aesthetic with a Gunmetal Black finish, this home theatre system perfectly complements any modern living room or office setup.
MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Seamlessly connect via Bluetooth for wireless streaming, or use the USB port, SD card slot, and AUX input to play music from your Smartphone, Laptop, PC, or Tablet.
FULL-FUNCTION REMOTE CONTROL: Adjust volume, switch input modes (BT/USB/FM/AUX), and skip tracks from the comfort of your sofa with the included sleek master remote.
BUILT-IN FM RADIO: Stay tuned to your favourite local stations with the integrated digital FM tuner, offering clear reception and easy station scanning for non-stop entertainment.
SMART TV & GAMING COMPATIBLE: Enhance your cinematic experience; this multimedia speaker system is designed to provide high-fidelity sound for LED TVs, Desktop Computers, and Gaming consoles.

PROUDLY MADE IN INDIA: Support local craftsmanship with the Tronica Dhurandhar home theater system, designed and manufactured in India to deliver premium sound quality and durable performance for Indian households.
description: Elevate Your Home Audio Experience- Bring the cinema to your living room with the Tronica Dhurandhar 30W 2.1 Bluetooth Home Theater System. This sleek, Gunmetal Black multimedia speaker system is engineered to deliver high-fidelity sound with a powerful punch, making it the perfect companion for your Smart TV, PC, or smartphone. Deep Bass & Crystal-Clear Audio- Featuring a dedicated wooden subwoofer, the Dhurandhar system produces rich, thumping bass that breathes life into movies and gaming. The dual satellite speakers ensure that vocals and high-frequency sounds remain crisp and distortion-free, even at high volumes. Seamless Wireless Connectivity- Equipped with advanced Bluetooth technology, you can stream your favourite playlists wirelessly from any Bluetooth-enabled device within a 10-metre range. No more messy wires—just pure, uninterrupted music. Designed for Modern Indian Homes- The compact, space-saving design fits perfectly on TV units or computer desks. The premium Gunmetal Black finish adds a touch of sophistication to any decor. With the fully functional remote control, you can switch modes, adjust volume, and skip tracks from the comfort of your couch.
